verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Snowflake's core RBAC model (privileges assigned to roles, roles to users) and Access History views tracking table/column-level query and write activity, which supports auditing at the object level. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of dynamic data masking policies or row access policies (row-level security), which are the specific mechanisms the story calls out for column- and row-level control — missing for 10: masking policy documentation, row access policy documentation, and any independent/hands-on confirmation these work as described.
